note: Chapter XVII fill shots (Ian, 16 Nov): exteriors, far angles, window views, down the hall — general shapes to rest the eye while the story is told.
style: A dark, atmospheric oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the reference: academic realism, deep chiaroscuro, a wide view from far back, the room or place more than the people. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: A wide view of a doctor's study in an asylum, 1893, seen from the far corner of the room: book-lined walls, a big desk, a phonograph with a brass horn, a tall window with afternoon light, a dark-haired young woman in black standing small in the doorway. Any people are small, distant figures with no detail in their faces.

Looking out through the tall window of the study from inside, 1893: the asylum lawn and elms in soft afternoon light, rain-streaked glass, heavy curtains framing it, the edge of a desk and a lamp in the foreground; the room quiet and empty.

A wide high view looking down the asylum staircase at night, 1893: a long stair hall with dark panelling, a candle carried by a small figure far below, shadows climbing the walls. Any people are small, distant figures with no detail in their faces.
A long, dim asylum corridor at dusk, 1893, seen from one end: polished floor reflecting a row of tall windows, doors along one side, a single gas jet lit far down the passage, empty.

A wide view of the study at night from the doorway, 1893: two small figures at a desk lit by one lamp, a typewriter and phonograph, stacks of paper, the rest of the big room sunk in brown-black shadow. Any people are small, distant figures with no detail in their faces.

A wide view of a drawing-room in the asylum, 1893, seen from the far end: grey afternoon light from tall windows, a fire, three small figures near the hearth, one man turned away with his face in his hands. Any people are small, distant figures with no detail in their faces.

A long asylum corridor in evening light, 1893: a man in a travelling coat stands far off at a window, a woman approaching him down the passage, the floor shining with reflected sunset. Any people are small, distant figures with no detail in their faces.

Exterior, the asylum at night, 1893, seen from the garden: dark mass of the building with a few windows lit gold, the moon behind thin cloud, and beyond the wall the black shape of the old house Carfax among trees.
